设
\[
I=\int_{-1}^1\frac{dx}{(1+e^x)(1+x^2)}.
\]
注意到
\[
\frac{1}{1+e^x}+\frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}=1.
\]
因此
\[
f(x)+f(-x)=\frac{1}{1+x^2}.
\]
所以
\[
I=\frac12\int_{-1}^1\frac{dx}{1+x^2}
=\frac12\left[\arctan x\right]_{-1}^1
=\frac12\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}
=\frac{\pi}{4}.
\]

答案：B
